test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Seven friends S1, S2, S3, S4, S5, S6 and S7 are sitting in a row facing towards north (not necessarily in the same order). S4 does not sit at any of the extreme ends. Only three friends sit between S5 and S7. Only two friends sit between S3 and S5. Both S5 and S7 do not sit at any of the extreme ends. S2 sits in the middle of the row.

Who are the neighbours of S2?
solution: From the given information: Step 1: S2 sits in the middle of the row. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79b206b08fc825ca55ec54932f052bb3b8947ad2693f4455e22c72a1c3b08785.png] We place S2 at fourth place because it is the middle from both the directions. Step 2: Only three friends sit between S5 and S7. Step 3: Only two friends sit between S3 and S5.
